title: Shrimp and Garlic Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish made with succulent shrimp, garlic, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the aromatic spices, floral water, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
